en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Zurara who said,
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The investigation would always suffice when one does not know the direction of the Qiblah’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad from Flariz from Zurarah who has said the following:
“Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Al-Taharriy (investigation) is always sufficient in the issue of finding al-Qiblah (al-Ka‘bah).’”
